tweets.text:
A five-state ICE @HSI_HQ and @DHSgov Cyber Crimes Center operation June 22-July 10 continued to decimate criminal “SIM farms” used to scam Americans out of about $15 million each year.

These “farms” house short message service gateways called “SIM boxes” that contain hundreds-to-thousands of cell phone SIM cards each that route massive volumes of disguised calls and texts for illegal scam calls, phishing texts and fraud schemes.

This recent operation surged special agents and analysts from 11 HSI field offices to high-risk areas, including Los Angeles, Miami, Tampa, Houston, Boston, New York and New Jersey.

HSI has disrupted 68 SIM farms in 15 states in similar operations since 2024 while seizing more than 500,000 SIM cards, 1,900 SIM boxes and $700,000 in illicit proceeds.

His criminal history also includes a 2025 charge of battery resulting in bodily injury.

Urbano Vazquez Ortega, of Mexico, SEXUALLY ASSAULTED KIDS WHILE A PRIEST working at a Washington, D.C., church — before, during and after his naturalization as a U.S. citizen.

A D.C. court convicted him on multiple counts of second-degree child sexual abuse and sentenced to 15 years in prison after he obtained citizenship.

He’s currently still in prison, but he’s also still a citizen.

The United States filed a five-count complaint against Mr. Vazquez Ortega to revoke his naturalized citizenship alleging he obtained citizenship fraudulently.
